in_marathi.name: Damanraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Controller of the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Damanraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Damanraj is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'daman' (control) and 'raj' (king). The name symbolizes the power of controlling one's own mind and ruling over it, which is considered a great virtue in Hinduism.
